goals.title: A week of posts
goals.summary: Five short posts for the week, each saved as a draft for you to approve.
goals.text: Write [number of posts] short posts for [channel] about [what we want to talk about] for the week starting [date]. Keep the tone [tone of voice]. Save each one as a draft with a planned day, and do not publish anything.

goals.title: A newsletter on one subject
goals.summary: One newsletter about a single subject, ready for you to read and approve.
goals.text: Write a newsletter for [who it is for] about [the one subject]. Open with a short hook, give [number of points] clear points, and end with one thing I want readers to do: [the one action]. Keep it as a draft for me to approve.

goals.title: Announce one thing
goals.summary: A post that announces a single thing, in a short and a longer form.
goals.text: Write a post for [channel] announcing [what is new]. Say who it helps, what changes for them and when: [date]. Give me a short version and a longer one, and leave both as drafts.

goals.title: Shorten last week's drafts
goals.summary: Last week's drafts rewritten in a shorter form, keeping the meaning.
goals.text: Take last week's drafts for [channel] and rewrite each one in a shorter form of about [number of words] words. Keep the meaning and the tone, and save the shorter ones as new drafts next to the old ones.

goals.title: A content plan for a month
goals.summary: A month of planned content, shown to you as a plan before any writing starts.
goals.text: Plan the content for [month] for [channel] aimed at [who it is for]. The main aim is [what we want to achieve]. Show me the plan first, with a subject and a day for each piece, and wait for my yes before writing anything.
